name: 44663 · New Phila, OH
findings: ZIP 44663 (New Phila) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44663 (New Phila) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
